THE PROBLEM

Why it matters

Shop owners need to see how the business is doing without exporting spreadsheets.

HOW IT WAS BUILT

Approach

A pure, tested `summarize()` function aggregates orders. Charts are hand-built SVG with tooltips, keyboard support and a table view.

Key features

  • 01KPIs versus previous period
  • 02Accessible SVG charts
  • 033D bar chart (custom engine)
  • 04Admin-only status changes
